name: The Ritz-Carlton Georgetown
insider_take: This historic Georgetown gem sits in a former 1930s incinerator building, transformed into luxury lodging where industrial heritage meets Ritz-Carlton elegance.
whats_special: The hotel's unique brick smokestacks have been preserved as architectural landmarks, while the location puts you steps from the C&O Canal towpath and Georgetown's cobblestone streets. The building's Art Deco details and soaring ceilings create an unexpectedly grand atmosphere in this intimate neighborhood setting.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view room to watch rowers glide by at sunrise, and take advantage of the hotel's proximity to the Kennedy Center - it's just a scenic 10-minute walk along the Potomac waterfront.
dont_miss: Exploring the Georgetown Waterfront Park at golden hour, browsing the historic shops along M Street, and discovering the hidden stairs featured in "The Exorcist" just blocks away on Prospect Street.
pros: Historic Georgetown location with cobblestone streets and waterfront charm
Luxury Ritz-Carlton service standards with personalized attention
Elegant rooms and suites with sophisticated Washington DC design
Prime location near Georgetown University and upscale shopping
cons: Limited parking availability in historic Georgetown area
Premium luxury pricing typical of Ritz-Carlton properties
